clue.text: Novelist, one like James with energy mostly dissipated

parts.note: Henry James is the novelist, so one sharing his first name is a Henry

indicators.note: dissipated means scattered, so the trimmed letters are rearranged
mostly means not quite all of the word, so its last letter goes

explanation.surface: A writer is likened to Henry James but lacks most of his vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts ENERGY to ENERG, and 'dissipated' scrambles that to GREEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry Green was an English writer of modernist fiction such as Loving and Party Going.

clue.text: Kästner's amateur detective gets computer tech to turn up ensign's wife

parts.note: Erich Kästner's children's book Emil and the Detectives has a boy sleuth, Emil

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: AI is artificial intelligence, a computer technology

explanation.surface: A fictional boy detective enlists technology to track down a soldier's wife.
explanation.walkthrough: In Othello Iago is Othello's ensign (ancient), and his wife is Emilia. 'to turn up' makes IA from AI.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Iago holds the rank of ensign, and the woman he married is Emilia.

clue.text: Logan's play about Rothko performed as edited

parts.note: John Logan's play Red is about the painter Mark Rothko
performed means acted

explanation.surface: A theatre piece about a painter is staged in a cut version.
explanation.definitionFit: A redacted text is one that has been censored or prepared for publication.

clue.text: Gully turning up say at west end of Oval

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the letters run from bottom to top

parts.note: say means for example, abbreviated EG

indicators.note: the west end of a word written left to right is its first letter

explanation.surface: Cricket talk of a fielding position at one end of the Oval ground.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oval is a London cricket ground and gully a fielding position, but here a gully is a narrow inlet. 'turning up' makes GE from EG.
explanation.definitionFit: A geo is a Scottish word for a narrow coastal inlet or ravine.

clue.text: Price of the St Simons Trilogy

definitions.text: Price of the St Simons Trilogy

parts.words: Price of the St Simons Trilogy
parts.note: reads like the cost of a set of books, but Price is the surname of the American novelist who wrote that trilogy about St Simons Island, Georgia

explanation.surface: How much a three-volume set of novels costs.
explanation.definitionFit: The American writer of the St Simons Trilogy had the first name Eugenia.

clue.text: Pseudonym of Rosemonde Pujol's Colinette?

parts.note: Rosemonde Pujol was a French Resistance fighter whose code name was Colinette: a false name taken for wartime action

explanation.surface: A question about the alias used by a French Resistance member.
explanation.definitionFit: A French phrase for a fighting alias, literally a war name, as taken by Resistance agents.

clue.text: Rage madly on film like King Kong

indicators.note: madly means wildly, so the letters of the word before it are jumbled

parts.note: film means to record on tape

explanation.surface: A giant beast storms furiously across the cinema screen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'madly' scrambles RAGE to GREA; 'on' just places it above TAPE in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: King Kong is a fictional giant gorilla, an example of a large primate.

clue.text: Knight is in pursuit of old underworld boss

indicators.note: in pursuit of means following behind, so these pieces come after the old

parts.note: a knight is addressed as Sir

explanation.surface: A gangster chief is chased by a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Osiris was the Egyptian god who ruled the land of the dead.

clue.text: Supplied with a touch of discipline within, like Jim Hawkins and friends under attack

definitions.text: like Jim Hawkins and friends under attack

indicators.note: within means these letters sit inside the other word

parts.note: supplied means stocked, as a shop with goods

indicators.note: a touch of a word is just its first letter

explanation.surface: Schoolboy heroes of an adventure, kept under some discipline during a siege.
explanation.walkthrough: In Treasure Island Jim Hawkins and the loyal party hold out in a log fort against the pirates.
explanation.definitionFit: Enclosed by a defensive palisade, as the Treasure Island party were in the log fort.

clue.text: Call of the Raven? Or Wraysford's story

definitions.meaning: a raven's cry is the voice of a bird
Stephen Wraysford is the hero of Sebastian Faulks's First World War novel

explanation.surface: A question about a bird's cry, or a soldier's tale.
explanation.definitionFit: The song of a bird, and also the title of Faulks's novel about Stephen Wraysford.

clue.text: Where you might get led to gold with difficulty?

definitions.text: Where you might get led to gold with difficulty?

indicators.note: might get suggests the word led ends up in some other form, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: or is heraldic gold
done with ado is done with trouble or fuss

explanation.surface: Seekers led through hardship toward a city of treasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might get' scrambles LED to ELD; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary city of riches sought by explorers in South America.

clue.text: 007 with scope to include a trace of organophosphate in a biological weapon

indicators.note: to include means the two joined words hold the extra letter between them

parts.note: James Bond, 007, is a secret agent
scope means range

indicators.note: a trace of a word is just its first letter

explanation.surface: A spy carries a poison as part of a germ weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: The defoliant sprayed in Vietnam, here loosely called a biological weapon since it attacked plant life.

clue.text: One's work with a political group, in progress

parts.note: a party is a political organization
going means under way

explanation.surface: Someone's job with a political organization, still ongoing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' is 1 across, Henry Green: several clues in this puzzle define one of his novels as 'one's work'.
explanation.definitionFit: Party Going is a 1939 novel by the writer at 1 across.

clue.text: Acted through Falstaff's opponent without me

parts.note: per means by way of, through

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so the word around the other piece

parts.note: in The Merry Wives of Windsor Master Ford outwits Falstaff

explanation.surface: Playing Falstaff's rival on stage, but leaving me out of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like a deletion signal, but in its old sense it means outside, as in the hymn's 'a green hill far away, without a city wall'.
explanation.definitionFit: Performed means gave a performance, as an actor does.

clue.text: Returned one's work

definitions.meaning: 'One' is 1 across, and this is a 1946 novel by that writer

explanation.surface: Someone came home with a piece of work.
explanation.definitionFit: To come back is to return, and Back is a novel by the writer at 1 across.

clue.text: Sculptor includes new part of opus in composition

indicators.note: includes means the sculptor's name holds the next letter inside

parts.note: Auguste Rodin was a French sculptor

indicators.note: part of a word here is its opening letter

explanation.surface: An artist works a fresh section of a piece into his creation.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondino is a short rondo, a type of musical piece.

clue.text: Memo about Miss Harker's present

indicators.note: about means going round, so the note surrounds the name

parts.note: a memo is a short note
Mina Harker is the heroine of Bram Stoker's Dracula

explanation.surface: A memo concerns a gift for a character from Dracula.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone forward as a candidate is to nominate them.

clue.text: When to tear things up, beginning with the old almanac firstly?

indicators.note: beginning with means the other pieces are put in front

parts.note: ye is an old form of 'the'

indicators.note: firstly means only the opening letter of the word is taken

parts.note: to rend is to tear apart

explanation.surface: An old calendar suggests a time to rip things up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tear things up' looks like part of the definition, but the definition is just 'When'; 'beginning with' sets the old article and the almanac's initial ahead of the tearing.
explanation.definitionFit: The close of a twelve-month period names a time, as 'when' asks.

clue.text: One to share with Mormon mostly disturbed and irritated

indicators.note: disturbed means stirred up, so the letters are rearranged
mostly means the final letter of the word is lost

parts.note: ate means irritated, as in what's eating you

explanation.surface: A housemate who is a Mormon becomes upset and annoyed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims MORMON to MORMO, which 'disturbed' turns into ROOMM.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sharing lodgings with another person.

clue.text: "Ivy … as good to grow on graves / As twist about a -" (E. B. Browning)

definitions.text: "Ivy … as good to grow on graves / As twist about a -" (E. B. Browning)

parts.words: "Ivy … as good to grow on graves / As twist about a -" (E. B. Browning)
parts.note: fill the blank in Elizabeth Barrett Browning's lines: the ivy-wreathed staff carried by Bacchus and his followers

explanation.surface: A line of Victorian verse about ivy with a word missing.
explanation.definitionFit: A staff tipped with a pine cone and twined with ivy, carried in Bacchic rites.

clue.text: Resistance beginning to support government marking

parts.note: the ohm is the unit of electrical resistance

indicators.note: beginning to means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Rebels propping up the state, and the official stamp involved.
explanation.walkthrough: On Her Majesty's Service is printed on British official mail.
explanation.definitionFit: The initials of On Her Majesty's Service, stamped on British state post.

clue.text: The Lord's Word mostly translated in Heaven and Hell?

indicators.note: translated means turned into another form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive adds no letter

indicators.note: mostly means losing the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: The scripture in another language speaks of the afterlife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts WORD to WOR; 'translated' scrambles THELORDWOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Heaven and Hell are examples of a realm beyond this life.

clue.text: Yearn to embrace girl in one's work

indicators.note: to embrace means to hold the other piece inside

parts.note: to yearn is to long
Vi is a short girl's name

explanation.surface: Wanting to hug a girl who appears in a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' is 1 across, Henry Green; this is his 1945 novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Loving is a novel by the writer at 1 across.

clue.text: Greek character consumed by inferior monster

indicators.note: consumed by means swallowed inside the other word

parts.note: minor means lesser
tau is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A figure from Greek myth eaten by a lesser monster.
explanation.definitionFit: The bull-headed beast of Cretan myth.

clue.text: One used to write a melody after turning to synaesthetic composer for starters — this one?

definitions.text: One used to write a melody after turning to synaesthetic composer for starters — this one?

indicators.note: for starters means the first letters of each of those words
after turning means these two pieces are read backwards together

parts.note: a nib is the point of a pen
an air is a tune

explanation.surface: A tune written by a composer who saw music as colours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after turning' makes RIABIN from NIBAIR, joined to the starters of 'synaesthetic composer'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian composer Scriabin linked musical keys with colours, a synaesthetic approach.

clue.text: Did Ophelia regret wearing it differently?

definitions.text: Did Ophelia regret wearing it differently?

parts.words: Did Ophelia regret wearing it differently?
parts.note: the verb meaning regret is also the herb Ophelia hands out in Hamlet, telling the Queen she must wear hers with a difference

explanation.surface: A question about whether Hamlet's Ophelia felt sorry.
explanation.definitionFit: To regret is to rue, and rue is the herb of grace Ophelia distributes.

clue.text: Director General into streaming one's work

indicators.note: streaming means flowing, so the letters of the word are shuffled

parts.note: G is an abbreviation for general

explanation.surface: A broadcasting chief gets into streaming a novel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Director General' is two abbreviations, D and G, which go round the anagram OTIN of INTO. 'One' is 1 across, Henry Green.
explanation.definitionFit: Doting is a 1952 novel by the writer at 1 across.

clue.text: Rugby scholar gets a measure of work involving for instance small confections

parts.note: Harry East is Tom Brown's friend at Rugby School in Tom Brown's Schooldays

indicators.note: involving means taking in the other piece

parts.note: the erg is a unit of work in physics
for instance is EG

explanation.surface: A public schoolboy works through some small treats.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby is an English public school; Harry East is a pupil in Tom Brown's Schooldays.
explanation.definitionFit: Chocolate eggs eaten at Easter are sweet treats.
